summary: TUI task snapshots over the production loop (TuiHarness): Esc/Ctrl-C with an idle draft keep it and send nothing; Esc and Ctrl-C interrupt a busy turn; Esc with an overlay (Ctrl-R history search) open does not interrupt; a paste carrying \n/exit and \n!rm and key Release events submit nothing; a folded paste submits its full text; /help round-trips without a provider request. text->tool->text and cross-tab approval stay in tui_task_tool_order and tui_approval_focus.
notes: Observed semantics recorded as-is: with a draft, Esc and Ctrl-C keep it (ZE-252 per-zone design, not pi clear-on-Ctrl-C). TUIs in one test process share ZENPI_HOME and are serialized (one production loop per process owns layout/checkpoint state). Paste folding starts above 1000 chars.
